bio.text: Diana Moreno represents the 36th Assembly District in Queens, which includes Astoria and Long Island City; she took office on February 4, 2026, less than twenty-four hours after winning a special election.
She was born and raised in Quito, Ecuador, and immigrated to the United States with her family at age 11.
Before the Assembly she worked as a labor organizer, including at New Immigrant Community Empowerment and, most recently, the New York State Nurses Association.
